summary: Hoffman Schroff Holdings, Inc., a Delaware finance subsidiary of nVent Electric plc, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for $800 million of 6.150% senior notes due 2036, guaranteed by nVent Electric plc and nVent Finance S.a r.l. Interest pays semi-annually March 15 and September 15 from March 15, 2027, with rating-based rate adjustments. Proceeds primarily fund nVent's previously announced Maverick Power acquisition. The offering is not contingent on that deal; if it is not consummated by the November 20, 2026 outside date (extendable to February 19, 2027) or is terminated, notes must be redeemed at 101% plus accrued interest. Notes are unsecured, rank pari passu with senior unsecured debt, issued in $2,000 minimums, and unlisted. Watch acquisition timing and any special mandatory redemption trigger.
